questions: Does 'at most two digits' refer to the absolute value of the integer, so -99 and 5 both qualify, but -100 and 100 do not?

If an element has leading zeros in its string representation (e.g., 005), should we count digits as in the integer value (5 has one digit) or as in the string representation (005 has three digits)?
